1: //! Small cross-platform helpers.
2: //!
3: //! Every target-specific value is selected through a single [`cfg_if!`] block
4: //! instead of a pile of `#[cfg(...)]` attributes. Adding a new platform is one
5: //! extra branch, and each branch stays flat and easy to read.
6: 
7: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
8: 
9: use cfg_if::cfg_if;
10: 
11: /// The platform this build targets.
12: pub struct Platform {
13:     /// Short name of the platform family.
14:     pub name: &'static str,
15:     /// Separator used between path components.
16:     pub path_separator: char,
17:     /// Line ending used by text files on the platform.
18:     pub line_ending: &'static str,
19: }
20: 
21: cfg_if! {
22:     if #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")] {
23:         /// The platform this build targets.
24:         pub const CURRENT: Platform = Platform {
25:             name: "wasm32",
26:             path_separator: '/',
27:             line_ending: "\n",
28:         };
29:     } else if #[cfg(windows)] {
30:         /// The platform this build targets.
31:         pub const CURRENT: Platform = Platform {
32:             name: "windows",
33:             path_separator: '\\',
34:             line_ending: "\r\n",
35:         };
36:     } else if #[cfg(unix)] {
37:         /// The platform this build targets.
38:         pub const CURRENT: Platform = Platform {
39:             name: "unix",
40:             path_separator: '/',
41:             line_ending: "\n",
42:         };
43:     } else {
44:         /// The platform this build targets.
45:         pub const CURRENT: Platform = Platform {
46:             name: "unknown",
47:             path_separator: '/',
48:             line_ending: "\n",
49:         };
50:     }
51: }
52: 
53: /// Joins `parts` with the target platform's path separator.
54: pub fn join(parts: &[&str]) -> String {
55:     parts.join(&CURRENT.path_separator.to_string())
56: }
57: 
58: /// Normalizes `text` to the target platform's line ending.
59: pub fn to_native_line_endings(text: &str) -> String {
60:     let unified = text.replace("\r\n", "\n");
61:     if CURRENT.line_ending == "\n" {
62:         unified
63:     } else {
64:         unified.replace('\n', CURRENT.line_ending)
65:     }
66: }
